feed.title: Greek News Aggregator — Daily Top Stories
feed.subtitle: Top stories scraped from kathimerini.gr

entry.title: Ελληνοτουρκικά: Νησιά χωρίς ασπίδα θέλει η Αγκυρα
entry.summary: Vassilis Nedos reads Fidan's claim that militarising the islands is a 'threat to Turkey' as an escalation strategy aimed at the restart of the Great Sea Interconnector under French flag and, above all, at the arms deals with Israel ('Achilles' Shield', PULS launchers from 2027). Foreign ministry spokesman Giannakoulias called labelling defensive fortification a 'threat' 'baseless and oxymoronic' while Turkey maintains a casus belli.

entry.title: Οι άνθρωποι πίσω από τον νέο πολιτικό φορέα του Κασιδιάρη
entry.summary: Leaving Domokos prison, Ilias Kasidiaris pledged to announce next Monday, via a YouTube address, the name, programme and sitting MPs of his new party, and the reasons it 'cannot be excluded from the elections'. Kathimerini reveals preparations began in summer 2025, with independent MP Giannis Dimitrokallis (ex-Spartans, a close associate of Kasidiaris) filing with the Supreme Court, helped by two more sitting MPs including Giorgos Manousos.

entry.title: Βουλή: «Πρόβα εκλογών» με φόντο το Σύνταγμα
entry.summary: The parliamentary debate on constitutional revision turned into an 'election rehearsal', a head-on Mitsotakis–Androulakis clash in a highly polarised tone. None of the 33 articles reached 180 votes (158–161), so the next parliament will need a supermajority, while PASOK voted 'present'. The PM leaned on stability and a third term, Androulakis pushed 'A Greece for all', and Mitsotakis pointedly left Tsipras 'out of the frame'.

entry.title: Νέα κλιμάκωση από Τουρκία για τα νησιά – Επιμένει στα περί αποστρατιωτικοποίησης
entry.summary: A day after Fidan, Turkish defence ministry spokesman Zeki Aktürk said actions creating faits accomplis in breach of Kastellorizo's demilitarised status 'will not be tolerated'. He described Mitsotakis's visit to the island and the display of military elements and a warship as incompatible with the 1947 Paris Treaty and as not contributing 'to peace and stability', pressing the demilitarisation narrative.

entry.title: Το κυνήγι της μαγικής θεραπείας
entry.summary: Alexis Papachelas sees in Mazonakis's death the absence of state and professional oversight, where 'anyone can advertise anything', but is more shocked by the profile of those who sought out the 'wizard doctors': serious, powerful, 'savvy' cosmopolitans who believed someone could cleanse their blood or make them 20–30 years younger. The Karneadou Street clinic, he writes, was Kolonaki's most widely shared 'secret', driven by vanity and naivety, with no one checking the 'miracles'.

entry.title: Απάντηση ΥΠΕΞ σε Φιντάν: Η Ελλάδα δικαιούται να λάβει όλα τα μέτρα για να διασφαλίσει τη νόμιμη άμυνά της
entry.summary: Foreign ministry spokesman Panagiotis Giannakoulias flatly rejected Fidan's claims, stressing that Turkish demilitarisation arguments 'lack any legal basis' and that Greece 'shapes its foreign policy sovereignly and is not dictated to'. He called branding defensive fortification a 'threat' 'baseless and oxymoronic' while Turkey maintains a casus belli, and underlined the country's right to lawful self-defence.

entry.title: Καύσιμα: Κοντά στα 2,20 ευρώ το λίτρο η μέση τιμή της αμόλυβδης
entry.summary: The national average price of unleaded hit 2.17 euros a litre on Wednesday (+6 cents in a week) and diesel 2.14 euros (+7 cents), with prices expected to keep rising. Government meetings are weighing intervention, with any measures due in early October, while the Eurogroup meets Friday in Dublin on the new energy crisis.

entry.title: Η Ολομέλεια του ΣτΕ θα αποφασίσει για τα μη κρατικά ΑΕΙ
entry.summary: A new round in the legal battle over non-state universities: first-year students at the Keele, York and Anatolia branches are preparing third-party challenges at the Council of State against rulings 1167–1172/2026 of its Third Section, which annulled licences and programme accreditations. Although licences were 'restored' after EOPPEP's lapses were cured, the annulment of accreditations for unspecified ETHAAE criteria left the 600 students in limbo despite minister Zacharaki's assurances. The plenary will decide.

entry.title: Οι «ολιστικοί» RFK Juniors της Ελλάδας
entry.summary: Xenia Kounalaki compares Greece's 'holistic' set to RFK Jr., prompted by Migration minister Thanasis Plevris's admission that he visited the doctor now prosecuted over Mazonakis's death, who prescribed him 'a diet with supplements'. She recalls Adonis Georgiadis's 'nanobionic vests' of 2017 and Athina Linou's claim that Covid does not spread at Holy Communion, concluding that the metaphysical should stay out of public health.

entry.title: ΟΗΕ: Δεν μπορούμε να αγνοήσουμε τους κινδύνους της τεχνητής νοημοσύνης
entry.summary: António Guterres warned leaders that 'rapidly developing' AI carries risks that cannot be ignored, 'especially when they come from those on the front line', in contrast to Trump, who deems existing safeguards sufficient. Concern rose after an Anthropic researcher resigned saying those building the systems 'believe it could kill us all by the end of the decade'. Guterres will make AI oversight central to his General Assembly talks.

entry.title: Η χώρα δεν έχει την πολυτέλεια
entry.summary: Nikos Filippidis warns the world economy is entering a crisis of 'unknown depth' – at once an energy and a bond crisis – while elections in Israel, the US and France and a possible fall of the Merz government after the AfD's Saxony triumph presage political instability, complicating the next EU budget and Lagarde's succession at the ECB. The 'most dangerous' domestic development, he writes, is the unprecedented toxicity among Greece's big business players, which the country cannot afford mid-crisis.

entry.title: Ηράκλειο: Απολογείται σήμερα η 18χρονη μητέρα για τον τραυματισμό του 17 ημερών βρέφους
entry.summary: The 18-year-old mother from Chania appears before the investigating magistrate today over the serious injury of her 17-day-old infant, who is in the neonatal ICU of Venizeleio hospital with severe head trauma, stable but critical, pending a decisive MRI. She first claimed the baby fell but then admitted striking it on the head, while the Smile of the Child said she had herself suffered abuse since the age of four.

entry.title: Αδωνις Γεωργιάδης: Μαζί
entry.summary: Michalis Tsintsinis reads the 'volcanic' mourning for Mazonakis in Nikaia – a crowd singing and dancing around the coffin – as a rare concentration of emotion that political professionals rushed not to leave 'unclaimed'. Adonis Georgiadis, he writes, appeared as the 'system' itself to apologise and divert the grief from flowing into political anger, but the source of the mass reaction was people's need for a shared experience.

entry.title: Δημοσκόπηση Pulse: Οριακή άνοδος για δύο μετά τις παρουσίες στη ΔΕΘ
entry.summary: The Pulse poll for SKAI has ND at 26.5% (+0.5 since July), Tsipras's ELAS flat at 15% and PASOK at 10.5% (+0.5). Greek Solution rose to 7.5%, Karystianou's party fell two and a half points to 5%, KKE is at 6% and Plefsi at 5%, with nine parties entering parliament. Antzoletos notes the 'needle' barely moved after the fair, as voters wait to see results in their pockets.

entry.title: Τραγωδία στη Γλυφάδα: Τρεις νεκροί μετά από τροχαίο στην Ποσειδώνος
entry.summary: Three people died in a crash shortly after 2 a.m. on the coastal Poseidonos avenue at Kalypsous Street in Glyfada, in the Athens-bound lane. The car carrying five people veered off the road; all were seriously injured and taken to Asklipieio hospital in Voula, where three died. The cause is unclear and traffic police are investigating whether another vehicle was involved.

entry.title: Μαρκ Κάρνεϊ: «Ισχυρότεροι μαζί» Ευρώπη και Καναδάς
entry.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney, addressing the European Parliament plenary, welcomed von der Leyen's proposal of 'associate member' status for the EU – an 'Alliance for the Future' – declaring that 'Europe and Canada are stronger together' and calling for deeper cooperation on defence, critical raw materials and technology. With barbs aimed at Trump's Washington, he clarified he is not proposing a 'third bloc' but resilience, so that no one can threaten their sovereignty and democracies.

entry.title: Microsoft: «Μια ανεξέλεγκτη ΑΙ μπορεί να γίνει ανταγωνιστική προς τον άνθρωπο»
entry.summary: Microsoft AI chief Mustafa Suleyman warned on the BBC that, without safeguards, AI could become 'a new species made of silicon' competing with humans for resources 'no matter how much it loves us'. He criticised as 'wrong' Anthropic's approach of treating Claude as if it had human attributes, while praising Dario Amodei as 'honest', and urged the industry not to build systems that set their own goals, earn money or own assets.

entry.title: AI: Ο κόσμος ανησυχεί, η Ευρώπη απουσιάζει
entry.summary: Athanasios Ellis welcomes that the debate on AI's dangers has finally opened, and by the technology's own pioneers, who can no longer ignore whether humans will keep control. Europe, however, is absent: last year the US produced 59 major models and China 35, the EU just two, and it lags badly in data centres, with the conversation effectively confined to the US and China.

entry.title: Δημοσκόπηση: Πώς κρίνουν οι πολίτες τις εξαγγελίες στη ΔΕΘ
entry.summary: An Opinion Poll survey for Action 24 puts ND at 25.7%, ELAS second and PASOK third, with the cost of living and inflation dominating public anxiety. Mitsotakis's overall fair plan is rated positively by 29.6% (45.6% not at all satisfied); the most popular measures are zero tax for families with three children (42.8%) and the minimum wage rise (39.1%). Androulakis's presentation gets just 16.4% approval, with the 13th salary and pension his top-rated pledge.

entry.title: Με πιστωτική κάρτα ή δανεικά πληρώνει λογαριασμούς το 56% των Ευρωπαίων
entry.summary: According to Intrum's Consumer Payment Report of 20,000 people in 20 countries, 29% of Europeans paid at least one bill late in the past 12 months (up from 24%), with Greece at 37%, third highest. The share borrowing or paying bills by credit card jumped to 56% from 45%, and to 60% in Greece, while BNPL and a return to the small shopkeeper's 'tab' gain ground as energy prices since late February eat into incomes.
